sections.heading: Verdict shape for Adapt.io
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Compare UpLead and Hunter for stronger mid-tier ranked peers, Apollo for data+sequences, and Cognism/Lusha for enrichment-first or EMEA motions..

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Outreach.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Starter, Basic, Custom.

sections.heading: Who Adapt.io is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Adapt.io when you want a credit-based mid-tier contact DB with Free + published Starter/Basic plans — treat it as landscape coverage, not a top ranked SI peer..

Avoid if: Compare UpLead and Hunter for stronger mid-tier ranked peers, Apollo for data+sequences, and Cognism/Lusha for enrichment-first or EMEA motions..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with UpLead on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Adapt.io price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Starter.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
